problem: OPEN-EXACT-BINDING-1 showed that v1 accepted alternate same-byte locator paths because path identity was neither authority-confined nor part of the common or per-cell canonical binding.

contract.input: five exact workspace-relative authority paths under one fixed root
contract.output: one owner-private closed manifest whose common and four per-cell identities include normalized exact paths, pinned modes, bytes, raw SHA-256 and canonical content SHA-256
contract.errors: deny on lexical, normalization, label, root, path, symlink, type, owner, mode, bytes, raw hash, content hash, canonical digest, cell equality, semantic, dependency or unresolved-pin drift

options.reason: Retains the demonstrated same-byte locator substitution gap.
Pins all five paths and duplicates the complete path/content identity into every cell while retaining dependency independence.
Creates competing authority copies and does not improve trust over fixed no-follow source reads.

read_boundary: workspace root -> pinned owned directory components with exact modes and O_NOFOLLOW -> pinned owned regular final file with exact mode

impact.rollback: remove v2 package; v1 and review remain immutable OPEN history

claim_limit: Provider-free exact path/content binding software evidence only; no live authority, countable result, provider/addon superiority, return claim, promotion or runtime acceptance.
